LeaseMode.description: Whether a Run survives its client's disconnection (RS-21).

oneOf.description: The Run ends when the client disconnects. The default (RS-21, RS-23).
The Run survives the disconnect until the TTL expires (RS-21, RS-23).

ttl_ms.description: How long, on the host monotonic clock (RS-22).

description: Who holds a Run, and for how long (RS-21…RS-25).

adoptions.description: How many times it has been adopted (RS-24).

expires_at_host.description: When it expires, on the host monotonic clock (RS-22).

holder.description: Who holds it now, uninterpreted by the Kernel (RS-24).

released.description: Whether it has been released (RS-6, step 8).

token.description:
Issued at grant for a Detached Lease; only `Adopt { token }` reclaims it
(RS-24, decision R5).
